steps.text: Fetch the eggs, mushrooms, creme fraiche, cheese and butter from the fridge

steps.text: Fetch the lettuce from the fridge and the oil, vinegar and mustard from the pantry

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Get the shallot and garlic and get out the frying pan, baking dish, cutting board, knife and grater
steps.checkpoint: tools are on the counter and shallot and garlic are out

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Wipe clean and slice the mushrooms

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Peel and finely chop the shallot and garlic

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Melt the butter in the pan and saute the shallot and garlic until soft
steps.checkpoint: shallot and garlic are soft in the pan

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Add the mushrooms and thyme and cook until browned, then season with salt and pepper
steps.checkpoint: mushrooms are browned and liquid has cooked off

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Stir the creme fraiche into the mushrooms and spread the mixture in the baking dish
steps.checkpoint: creamy mushrooms fill the baking dish

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Make wells in the mushrooms and crack an egg into each
steps.checkpoint: eggs sit in wells in the mushroom mixture

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top and season
steps.checkpoint: cheese covers the eggs and mushrooms

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Bake until the whites are set and the yolks still soft, about 12 to 15 minutes
steps.checkpoint: whites are set and cheese is melted

steps.text: Wash and spin dry the lettuce and tear it into the salad bowl
steps.checkpoint: clean dry leaves are in the bowl

steps.text: Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper into a dressing
Warm the baguette slices in the oven for a few minutes
Toss the salad with the dressing just before serving

steps.component: baked eggs with mushrooms and creme fraiche
steps.text: Serve the baked eggs with the salad and baguette on the table
